title: Honda Sharpens Civic Type R for 2027

body_markdown:
Come 2027, the Honda Civic Type R will have been available in the U.S. for a decade, and globally for 30 years.


Marking the occasion is a host of upgrades for Honda’s hot hatch that should make it even more of a hoot to drive.


First up is some suspension fettling, which means that when you engage +R mode, there’s a bit more compliance, with less bouncing and impact harshness. In turn, that provides greater stability and improved handling. The engineers have added a yoke spring to the brake pedal to remove play and deliver a more direct response and feel when you hit the anchors. As you row the six-speed manual transmission toward a bend, the Type R’s rev-match system reacts faster for smoother downshifts. Individually, they’re just incremental changes, but together should add up to increased driver confidence and more pace across your favorite back road.


Honda


There are visual tweaks too, with a new front fascia that improves cooling and a deeper front splitter for a tad more downforce. Meteorite Gray Metallic paint is now an option, alongside Boost Blue Pearl, Sonic Gray Pearl and Honda Championship White. Popping the hood now reveals an engine cover that’s been designed to evoke the earliest JDM Type Rs for extra cars and coffee kudos.


Honda


Moving inside, the big news is that the Civic Type R finally gets heated seats so you can enjoy a truly toasty track day, no matter the weather. There’s an updated perforation design for the suede-style upholstery, designed to help hold you in place during high-speed corners. You’ll now find Ultrasuede on the instrument panel and doors to upgrade the interior ambience, and a darker hue for the Type R’s trademark aluminum shift knob.


Honda


On the tech side, Google and Alexa are built into the infotainment system, and there are also updates to the Honda Sensing suite of driver aids, including Post-Collision Braking, which is there to limit damage from multi-crash collisions.


The 2027 Honda Civic Type R hits dealerships imminently with an MSRP of $48,695.
